question: Find the distance from the centroid to the vertex if the median is 9 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Centroid divides the median in a ratio of 2 : 1 from the vertex to the side.

Required distance = (2 / 3) × Median length

Distance = (2 / 3) × 9 cm

Distance = 2 × 3 = 6 cm

**∴ Answer = 6 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the median = 9 cm

**Formula used:**

In a triangle, the centroid (G) divides each median (AD) in the ratio AG : GD = 2 : 1, where A is the vertex.

 
 
• A (Vertex) G (Centroid) D (Midpoint) 
• 2 units (6 cm) 
• 1 unit (3 cm) Median = 9 cm 

**Calculations:**

Let the ratio parts of the median be 2x and 1x.

⇒ Total length of median = 2x + 1x = 3x

⇒ 3x = 9 cm

⇒ x = 9 ÷ 3 = 3 cm

⇒ Distance from centroid to vertex = 2x

⇒ Distance = 2 × 3 = 6 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6 cm (Option 2).**
